corrected_findings.complete_checksum_bound_output: Canonical acceptance no longer accepts caller-authored artifact rows or one unattached receipt hash. It resolves exactly item_count live tenant-owned artifact commit receipts, derives the output rows, and exact-matches revision, lane, job, item, key, bytes, checksum, and probe to one separately signed successful provenance item per batch item.
corrected_findings.database_bypass_fence: Additive migration 0027 persists the exact receipt-hash manifest and replaces the canonical-output trigger with the same batch-completeness, signed-item, artifact-receipt, ownership, lineage, checksum, byte-count, and probe joins.
corrected_findings.status_and_result_discovery: A persisted assignment is not called terminal until an authoritative status poll observes a terminal provider state. Before terminal observation, polling remains eligible through request TTL plus the 1800-second worst-case result-retention horizon; after observation, the exact persisted observation-plus-1800-second boundary applies.
corrected_findings.durable_output_truth: Reconciliation's durable_output_present fact now queries an accepted canonical output row instead of treating a provenance receipt as the output itself.

unproven: Live RunPod result timestamps, delivery, duplicate execution, cancellation, billing, concurrency, and zero-worker drain were not exercised.
Hosted R2 and non-superuser Neon RLS remain later proof gates.
Lane-specific Serverless init, execution, TTL, and scaler behavior remain later measured gates; V2-04 preserves provisional provider-free bounds only.
V2-05 active-runtime composition has not started.
